source_review_only_gaps: google.go ImportedEvent keeps RemoteID/LocalDate/start minutes/duration but loses separate all-day end date, is-all-day flag, calendar/series/original-start identity, ETag/revision and named timezone.
normalizeGoogleEvent stores multiday all-day as duration on its first date; source-reviewed, not tested against real provider.
normalizeGoogleEvent requires valid start/end even for cancelled events; a cancellation payload containing only identity/status would be omitted. Source-reviewed, not executed.

SQLiteRepository.Sync is fixture-only: writes fixed synthetic events and counters, not GoogleAdapter ingestion. No live provider connection observed in actual UI.
